title: 第9章 灌顶第10章 猎杀二阶灵兽
slug: 伏天鼎第3279章电话沟通误会
content_zh:
“少爷，小瑶明白了！”小瑶声音坚定地说道。
“好！这枚灵戒给你，你滴血认主！”
秦伏天从那七枚灵戒当中取出一枚，递给小瑶。
秦青瑶接过灵戒，戴在手指上。
这枚灵戒是那个持剑女子的灵戒，大小正好合适。
“还有这一株乌青草，你现在吃了！”
秦伏天又取出了一枚形状如蕨草的灵草，递给秦青瑶。
秦青瑶依言照做。
“现在，你开始修炼！”
在秦伏天的指引下，秦青瑶开始修炼。
她修炼的法诀，是一门名为《真灵玄水诀》的神界秘法。
秦伏天将秦青瑶的体质仔细查探了一遍，然后搜罗自己记忆当中的所有功法，发现这门神界的无上秘法——《真灵玄水诀》，最为适合秦青瑶修炼。
在秦青瑶盘膝修炼的同时，秦伏天一只手放在秦青瑶的头顶，接着他开始引导天地灵气聚拢，然后以灌顶之法，将其中一缕灵气度入秦青瑶的体内。
秦青瑶很快便感应到了一丝灵气入体，她连忙运转《真灵玄水诀》，引导这一丝灵气进入到丹田之中。
有了这个开头，接下来吸收灵气入体，便是变得顺理成章。
此时这个小丫头恐怕还不知道，秦伏天在她身上施展的灌顶之法，是何等的神妙。
灌顶之法，听起来似乎简单，但实则乃是逆天神通。
即便是这个世界最厉害的武圣，也未必通晓此术！
秦青瑶在修炼的同时，秦伏天则是静静地坐在一旁，不知不觉当中，他好像进入到了一种玄妙的状态。
他的呼吸，开始进入到一种特定的节奏，仿佛和大自然融合为一。

《龟息术》！
这门秘法，和《造化吞天诀》简直就是相辅相成，相得益彰！
不知不觉……
三天时间过去！
秦青瑶停止了修炼，她将胸腔之中的一口浊气长长吐出，睁开眼眸，一双眸子变得比三日之前要灵动、清澈了许多。
秦伏天也在此时睁开眼来，看向秦青瑶。
秦青瑶的气质和三日之前，已是截然不同。
引灵气入体，踏入武道，这便是生灵的一步，是极为重要的蜕变。
无法自主吸收灵气，永远不具备“灵”性。
而现在秦青瑶的身上便有了这种“灵”性，所以她整个人看起来比之前要灵动得多。
之前一段时间，秦青瑶每天省吃俭用，还辛苦做工，整个显得很是憔悴和疲惫。
而现在，憔悴和疲惫的一面已然一扫而空，整个人看上去精气神都很饱满。
原本秦青瑶五官就很不错，现在加之灵气的洗礼，还有《真灵玄水诀》这门秘法的加持，整个人即便和云仓城第一女神姜云岚相比，也是不遑多让。
“现在感觉怎样？”秦伏天问道。
“我现在感觉很好，少爷。就好像，有用之不尽的力量！”秦青瑶很是欣喜，一双秀手紧握成拳头，满脸激动。
“少爷。谢谢你！”秦青瑶又道。
秦青瑶从来都没有想过，她有朝一日竟然能够修炼。
在天念大陆，作为万物灵长的人类，有亿万万之数。
content_en:
"Master, Xiaoyao understands!" Xiaoyao said firmly.
"Okay! I'll give you this spiritual ring. You can shed your blood to recognize its owner!"
Qin Futian took out one of the seven spiritual rings and handed it to Xiaoyao.
Qin Qingyao took the spiritual ring and put it on her finger.
This spiritual ring is the spiritual ring of the woman holding the sword, and it is just the right size.
"There is also this black green grass, you can eat it now!"
Qin Futian took out another spiritual grass shaped like a fern and handed it to Qin Qingyao.
Qin Qingyao did as he was told.
"Now, you start practicing!"
Under the guidance of Qin Futian, Qin Qingyao began to practice.
The method she practices is a secret method from the divine realm called "True Spirit Xuan Shui Jue".
Qin Futian carefully checked Qin Qingyao's physique, then searched all the exercises in his memory, and found that this supreme secret method of the God Realm - "True Spirit Xuanshui Jue" is most suitable for Qin Qingyao to practice.
While Qin Qingyao was practicing cross-legged, Qin Futian put a hand on the top of Qin Qingyao's head, and then he began to guide the spiritual energy of heaven and earth to gather, and then used the initiation method to transfer a ray of spiritual energy into Qin Qingyao's body.
Qin Qingyao soon felt a trace of spiritual energy entering her body. She quickly ran the "True Spirit Xuan Shui Jue" to guide this trace of spiritual energy into her Dantian.
With this beginning, it becomes logical to absorb spiritual energy into the body.
At this time, this little girl probably still doesn't know how wonderful the initiation method Qin Futian used on her is.
The method of initiation may sound simple, but in fact it is a magical power that defies heaven.
Even the most powerful martial saint in the world may not be proficient in this technique!
While Qin Qingyao was practicing, Qin Futian was sitting quietly aside. Unknowingly, he seemed to have entered a mysterious state.
His breathing began to enter a specific rhythm, as if blending with nature.
"Turtle Breath Technique"!
This secret method and the "Good Fortune Swallowing Heaven Technique" simply complement each other and bring out the best in each other!
Unknowingly...
Three days have passed!
Qin Qingyao stopped practicing. She exhaled a long breath of turbid air in her chest and opened her eyes. Her eyes became much more lively and clear than three days ago.
Qin Futian also opened his eyes at this time and looked at Qin Qingyao.
Qin Qingyao's temperament is completely different from that of three days ago.
Introducing spiritual energy into the body and stepping into the martial arts is a step for a living being, and it is an extremely important transformation.
Unable to absorb spiritual energy on one's own initiative, one will never possess "spiritual" nature.
But now Qin Qingyao has this kind of "spirituality" in her body, so she looks much more agile than before.
Some time ago, Qin Qingyao lived frugally and worked hard every day, looking very haggard and tired.
But now, the haggard and tired side has disappeared, and the whole person looks full of energy.
Originally Qin Qingyao's facial features were very good, but now with the baptism of spiritual energy and the blessing of the secret method "True Spirit Xuanshui Jue", even compared with Jiang Yunlan, the first goddess of Yuncang City, she is not far behind.
"How do you feel now?" Qin Futian asked.
"I feel very good now, young master. It's like I have inexhaustible power!" Qin Qingyao was very happy, her hands clenched into fists, her face full of excitement.
"Master. Thank you!" Qin Qingyao said again.
Qin Qingyao never thought that one day she would be able to practice.
In Tiannian Continent, there are billions of human beings who are the primates of all things.
